# streamlit-analytics2

> Privacy-first usage analytics for Streamlit apps. One `with` block records
> pageviews, visits, visitors, widget interactions and custom events, shows a
> dashboard at `?analytics=on`, and keeps an event log you own (JSONL or
> SQLite). No JavaScript, no cookies, no IP addresses stored.

Package: `streamlit-analytics2` on PyPI. Import name: `streamlit_analytics2`.
Python 3.10+, Streamlit 1.47+. MIT.

## Minimal integration

```python
import streamlit as st
import streamlit_analytics2 as sa2

with sa2.track():
    st.button("Click me")
```

Open the app with `?analytics=on` to see the dashboard.

## Persist across restarts

- `sa2.track(save_to_json="analytics.json")`: counters in that file, events in `analytics.events.jsonl`.
- `sa2.track(events_path="analytics.db")`: SQLite event log; enables the SQL query tab.
- `sa2.track(store=obj)`: any object with `append(events)` and `read() -> list[Event]`.

## Other arguments of track(), start_tracking(), stop_tracking()

`unsafe_password` (dashboard password; also gates reset and the query tab),
`load_from_json`, `store_values` (record typed text, default False),
`session_id`, `firestore_key_file`, `firestore_collection_name`,
`firestore_document_name`, `firestore_project_name`,
`streamlit_secrets_firestore_key`, `verbose`.

## Custom events

`sa2.event("report generated", rows=12)` inside the tracked block.

## Data model

Append-only events with fields: ts (ISO 8601 UTC), kind (session | pageview |
run | widget | custom), session, visitor (daily-rotating hash), page, name,
widget_id, widget_type, key, value, props (JSON: browser, os, device, locale,
timezone, theme, utm_*). `streamlit_analytics2.data` holds the legacy
aggregate counters (total_pageviews, total_script_runs, total_time_seconds,
per_day, widgets).

## Privacy defaults

Stored: hashed visitor id that rotates daily, browser/OS/device family,
language, timezone, theme, UTM tags, pages, widget type/label/key/chosen
option. Not stored: IP, raw User-Agent, query strings, typed text (unless
`store_values=True`).
